scope: Top-level DIMSTYLE group 105 is registered as the record identity within processDimStyle, with repeated group 105 in a single record rejected. Application payload is consumed by the existing entry parser; legacy DIMBLK group 5 remains a name. No DRW_Dimstyle public data layout or direct parseCode contract is changed.

authority.title: Autodesk symbol table group codes
authority.role: DIMSTYLE record identity uses group 105; group 5 has an earlier name role.

originalSource.provenance: Independent repository sample; native authoring history not independently certified.
originalSource.observation: Complete identity census, 995 records, 1003 candidates and zero unmatched admissions. The six DIMSTYLE group-105 identities 27, E1, 39A, 994, B06 and C88 are now Outer/Accepted with zero repeated admissions, previously Outer/Unobserved. AC1018 adapter namespace remains gated.

counterfactual.provenance: Locally authored scratch AC1018 ASCII controls; no committed drawing fixtures.
counterfactual.trigger: DIMSTYLE group 105=41 followed by POINT group 5=41; corrected control uses POINT 42.
counterfactual.before: DIMSTYLE was unobserved and the colliding POINT was accepted.
counterfactual.after: DIMSTYLE is Accepted and colliding POINT is Duplicate; compatible typed entity handling drops its conflicting handle and import succeeds. Corrected POINT 42 is accepted.

validation.controls: Eight authored AC1018/AC1032 ASCII/binary, observer on/off routes; eight softened later collisions; 32 prior-collision, duplicate-105 or malformed refusals and corrected retries; one R12 ASCII absent-identity control. Also checks application 105 against a later POINT and nonhex DIMBLK group 5.

limitations: Existing table-entry duplicate policy rejects an earlier registered identity collision; later typed-entity duplicates are softened and recorded. This does not promise every malformed file fails import.

Table control handles and other families have separate admission behavior. The original AC1018 adapter namespace remains gated; identity, ownership, graph, output and native semantic support are not established.
Focused checks only; no full test suite or native platform qualification is claimed.
